libfprint on Omarchy

The library that lets Linux talk to your fingerprint reader.

Package data synced 2026-10-19 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install libfprint on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add libfprint-git. It is a 522.9 KB download (2.2 MB installed), version 1:1.94.100.r10.g6f9479c-3, licensed LGPL-2.1-or-later. Library for fingerprint readers (pinned upstream snapshot with FocalTech and Synaptics 06cb:010b support, and Apple Touch ID on aarch64). Free and open source.

Install libfprint on Omarchy

libfprint is the core software library that handles low-level communication with fingerprint scanning hardware and processes the fingerprint image data it captures. It is not something end users interact with directly; instead, system services like fprintd (which exposes fingerprint scanning over D-Bus) and desktop settings panels such as GNOME's Users settings build fingerprint login on top of it. This -git build tracks the current development branch with FocalTech MOC (Match-on-Chip) sensor support included, ahead of the stable release.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add libfprint-git
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1:1.94.100.r10.g6f9479c-3:
    pacman -Qi libfprint-git

Open and use libfprint

libfprint has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql libfprint-git | grep /usr/bin/

libfprint requirements and compatibility

  • a supported fingerprint reader (e.g. FocalTech Match-on-Chip devices for this build)
  • a service like fprintd, plus desktop or PAM integration, to actually use it for login

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • gcc-libs
  • glib2
  • glibc
  • libgudev
  • libgusb
  • openssl
  • pixman

Pricing and license

Free and open source. License: LGPL-2.1-or-later.

Frequently asked questions

How do I install libfprint on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add libfprint-git. The download is 522.9 KB and it takes 2.2 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is libfprint free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed LGPL-2.1-or-later.

How do I uninstall libfprint?

Run omarchy pkg drop libfprint-git. It removes the package from your system.

What does libfprint depend on?

The package declares 7 dependencies: gcc-libs, glib2, glibc, libgudev, libgusb, openssl, pixman. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is libfprint a desktop app?

No. libfprint has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is libfprint in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as libfprint-git (version 1:1.94.100.r10.g6f9479c-3) in the official Omarchy package repository. freedesktop.org contributors makes it. Project site: https://fprint.freedesktop.org/. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
